versions.content: A call to J1939Nm_NetworkRelease shall set all NodeChannels of the reported channel to ‘SleepMode’. The J1939 Network Management module shall notify this mode change to the NM Interface via Nm_BusSleepMode, and shall report a state change to ‘SleepMode’ to the NM Interface via Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP) and to BswM via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP).
